df <- read_csv("data/METABRIC_RNA_Mutation.csv")





Extract clinical and expression columns


Code
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# Split the column names into the 3 types (same logic as your Python code)
clinical_cols <- names(df)[1:31]

mutation_cols <- names(df)[str_detect(tolower(names(df)), "_mut$")]

expression_cols <- setdiff(names(df)[32:ncol(df)], mutation_cols)

# Select clinical + gene expression only (drops the mutation columns)
df_ce <- df |>
  select(all_of(c(clinical_cols, expression_cols)))

title: Term project of Survival Analysis course
text:
Biological pathway selection
4 biological pathways:

Estrogen / hormone signaling
PI3K–AKT–mTOR signaling
Cell cycle / proliferation
DNA repair



Code
hallmark <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "H")

pathway_map <- tribble(
  ~gs_name,                           ~pathway,
  "HALLMARK_ESTROGEN_RESPONSE_EARLY", "Estrogen / hormone signaling",
  "HALLMARK_ESTROGEN_RESPONSE_LATE",  "Estrogen / hormone signaling",
  "HALLMARK_PI3K_AKT_MTOR_SIGNALING", "PI3K-AKT-mTOR signaling",
  "HALLMARK_E2F_TARGETS",             "Cell cycle / proliferation",
  "HALLMARK_G2M_CHECKPOINT",          "Cell cycle / proliferation",
  "HALLMARK_DNA_REPAIR",              "DNA repair"
)


Summary how many genes per pathway are available


Code
pathway_genes <- hallmark |>
  inner_join(pathway_map, by = "gs_name") |>
  distinct(pathway, gene_symbol) |>
  mutate(gene_lower = tolower(gene_symbol))   # your columns are lowercase (e.g. brca1)


# Use the FULL data frame, not the one trimmed with select(1:31)
data_genes <- tolower(names(df))

pathway_genes <- pathway_genes |>
  mutate(in_data = gene_lower %in% data_genes)

# Summary: how many genes per pathway are available
pathway_genes |>
  group_by(pathway) |>
  summarise(
    total_genes = n(),
    genes_available   = sum(in_data),
    percentage         = round(100 * genes_available / total_genes, 1)
  )


# A tibble: 4 × 4
  pathway                      total_genes genes_available percentage

1 Cell cycle / proliferation           327              38       11.6
2 DNA repair                           150               3        2  
3 Estrogen / hormone signaling         299              16        5.4
4 PI3K-AKT-mTOR signaling              105              24       22.9

text:
KM-curve


Code
df_clust %<>%
  mutate(surv = case_when(death_from_cancer == "Living" ~ 0, .default = 1))

survfit2(Surv(overall_survival_months, surv) ~ cluster_k2, data = df_clust) |>
  ggsurvfit() +
  add_confidence_interval() +
  labs(x = "Time (months)", y = "Overall survival probability",
       color = "Cluster", fill = "Cluster") +
  scale_ggsurvfit() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
